ops.body: A3.2 refuter round (sol xhigh, read-only on e5f3afff): NOT clean — 2 HIGH, 1 MED, 1 LOW. Confirmed held under adversarial pressure: billed-retry double-count fix, read-tree classification, bool-cost handling, produced-file semantics, and the new tests genuinely pin pre-fix behavior. Gaps → A3.3 (task in flight, release stays blocked): F1 HIGH — a billed proposal whose propose() never returned (wall cancel lands mid-poll AFTER the process exited and wrote its cost envelope) is recorded zero times (no sidecar, no journal; driver.py:207/211, loop.py:347/386); fix = recovery-at-cancel: shielded envelope read + sidecar flush in the BaseException path after stop(); invariant: any billed cost is durably recorded before the exception escapes. F2 HIGH — json.loads accepts NaN; a NaN sidecar cost passes the numeric type check, infra_cost() returns nan, and every spent>max_usd comparison goes False → budget enforcement silently disabled (failures.py:140, loop.py:330); fix = malformed-skip requires finite AND non-negative; verify the journal-row boundary too. F4 LOW — wall-cancel flush events inflate MorningReport.infra_retries (retros/proposer consume it); count only genuine retry events. F3 MED ACCEPTED as documented limitation, not fixed: shielded-flush I/O failure (ENOSPC during wall-cancel) loses the cost but the run crashes loudly — guarding a doubly-degraded state is defensive coding; one docstring sentence documents the resume-side ledger check. Verify loop: athome-a32-verify re-refutes each round until a clean pass — that is the release gate.
